target: target_<treatment> (change in AP points, poll w to w+1)
selection_rule: Use linear unless gbt holdout MAE < 0.9 x linear holdout MAE. Applied once, per treatment, when the holdout is scored.
pass_criteria: Chosen model beats baseline on holdout MAE, and its predicted end-of-season top 25 has Spearman >= 0.7 with the real 2024 and 2025 final polls.
collinearity_note: margin = points_for - points_against, home + away + neutral = wins + losses = games, bye = (games == 0). Predictions are unaffected; individual linear coefficients within these groups are not separately identifiable.
